title.zh: 设置单条数据集行列权限配置信息
title.en: Set Single Dataset Row and Column Permission Configuration Information

descriptions.zh: >：当前接口仅支持Quick BI新版行列权限模型。若您仍在使用老的行列权限，请先一键迁移至新的行列权限模型后再调用该接口。一键迁移至新的行列权限模型的操作步骤：在组织管理-->安全配置-->行列权限升级新版中，单击**一键升级**，升级至新版行级权限。
descriptions.en: > This interface only supports the new row and column permission model of Quick BI. If you are still using the old row and column permissions, please migrate to the new row and column permission model before calling this interface. Steps to migrate to the new row and column permission model: In Organization Management --> Security Configuration --> Upgrade Row and Column Permissions to New Version, click **One-Click Upgrade** to upgrade to the new row-level permissions.
